settings.label: A golf bag should look intentional, not assembled by accident.
Core accessory categories organized around color and purpose.

settings.title: Accessories that belong together
settings.text: Built Birdie is for golfers who care about the full setup: towel, brush, headcover, marker, cart, and the little extras that make a round feel cleaner.

settings.title: Simple colors. Better decisions.
settings.text: Start with a base bag color, choose an accent, and use the system to keep every add-on aligned.

settings.title: No random pile of gear
settings.text: The shop is organized around kits and use cases so golfers can build a tighter setup without digging through endless product pages.

settings.heading: Golf accessories with a system.
settings.subheading: Built Birdie is a modern golf accessories brand built around coordinated setups, clean bags, and useful details that look like they were chosen on purpose.
